title: Concept: Inline event handler shipped in markup
description: Inline handlers are the mechanism cross-site scripting needs: if the policy allows them, an injected attribute executes just like the page's own code, so the page has no script boundary to lose.
applicability: Legacy front ends, server-rendered templates and third-party widgets embedded without a policy.
risk: An injection point anywhere on the page escalates from markup to script execution, which reads tokens, rewrites forms and drives the session.
